title: Slack User token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: XOXP- vs the provider-documented lowercase xoxp- and prefix namespace: xoyp- breaks the xox stem every documented Slack token prefix shares (the registry slack-token twin precedent, xoyb-). Twin of "Slack User token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of slack-user-token-dotenv: prefix namespace: xoyp- breaks the xox stem every documented Slack token prefix shares (the registry slack-token twin precedent, xoyb-). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
